'''Lubrication droids''' were a type of industrial [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. They were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on their [[Imperial mining complex|mobile mining operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alabash]] under the command of [[Control (droid)|Control]], a [[Terreene Brainiac]] class of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]].<ref name="Freedom" />
